task.title: Store shelf and stock check
task.description: With store permission, observe three agreed product SKUs at one agreed store in Seoul. Record shelf availability and displayed prices; distinguish observed absence from confirmed stockout. Do not photograph customers or enter restricted areas.
task.acceptanceCriteria: A timestamped observation for each SKU, permitted shelf photos, displayed prices and any access or verification limitations.

items.observation: Not visible on the agreed shelf; stockout not confirmed

limitations: Staff stock confirmation was outside the agreed scope.
